releaseNotes: 12 Modern Speedometer Styles: 1) Dynamic Sweep Arc, 2) Classic Analog Dial, 3) Simple Digital, 4) Cyberpunk TFT Bar Matrix, 5) Fighter Jet Aviation HUD, 6) Apex Superbike Track Dial, 7) Hypercar Concentric Dual Halo, 8) 1980s Retro Digidash Tape, 9) Scandinavian Minimalist Radial Ring, 10) Sci-Fi Hexagonal Pod, 11) Vintage Cafe Racer with Rolling Tumbler Odometer, 12) MotoGP Vertical Velocity Column. Fully animated, theme-aware, and selectable in Settings & Custom Mode.
